fix: v1.8.39 - fix race conditions in account operations, simplify account switching to follow local client only

### Fixed
- Race conditions: multiple account operations executing concurrently causing inconsistent state
  - Added account operation mutex lock for serialized execution
  - Fixed startup account sync racing with user operations
  - Fixed deleted accounts being auto-reimported (added blacklist mechanism)
- Account switching still detecting Antigravity Tools accounts

### Changed
- Account switching now follows local Antigravity client only (state.vscdb)
  - Startup auto-syncs to local client's login (silent import and switch)
  - Switch to Current Login button only detects local client
- Antigravity Tools sync now only imports accounts, no longer auto-switches
- Removed Auto Switch Account checkbox from Account Sync Settings modal

fix(security): XSS vulnerabilities in webview JavaScript files

- accounts_overview.js:
  - Added sanitizeUrl() function to validate image URLs
  - Added sanitizeClassName() function for safe CSS class names
  - Applied escapeHtml() to filter options and tier badges
  - Validated image URLs in showAnnouncementPopup and showImagePreview

- dashboard.js:
  - Added sanitizeClassName() helper function
  - Applied escapeHtml() to user inputs: email, model names, group names
  - Secured innerHTML assignments in:
    - renderModelCard()
    - renderGroupCard()
    - renderCustomGroupingContent()
    - model selection dropdown
    - account info display

- dashboard_announcements.js:
  - Added sanitizeUrl() and sanitizeClassName() functions
  - Validated image URLs before setting src attributes
  - Used DOM API instead of innerHTML for error messages
  - Applied escapeHtml() to announcement content

This addresses CodeQL security alerts #20, #21, #23-31, #34, #37, #43-47
